headlines.title: 정부 “ 홈플러스 6월 임금 333억원 체불 … 대지급금 신속 지원 ”
headlines.summary: 정부가 홈플러스의 지난달 임금체불 규모를 333억원으로 확인하고, 피해 근로자를 위해 대지급금을 신속 지원하기로 했다. 이형일 재정경제부 1차관은 10일 정부세종청사에서 관계기관 전담반(TF) 회의를 열고 홈플러스 사태 관련 피해 상황과 관련 지원 이행 실적을 점검했다. TF 전수조사 결과 홈플러스의 6월 임금 체불액은 333억원으로 확인됐다.

headlines.title: 홈플러스 6월 임금체불 333억 원… 정부, 1인당 최대 2100만원 신속 지급
headlines.summary: 재경부 등 관계기관 합동 TF 노조, 14일  김광일 MBK 부회장 면담 10일 대구시청 산격청사 앞에서 홈플러스 성서점 입점 점주들이 지속 영업 보장을 요구하는 기자회견을 열고 있는 모습. ⓒ연합뉴스 법원의 홈플러스 기업회생절차 폐지 결정 이후 정부가 피해 상황을 전수조사한 결과, 6월분 임금 체불액이 333억원으로 확인됐다.

headlines.title: 정부 " 홈플러스 임금체불 333억 원 확인 "… 협력업체 금융지원 확대
headlines.summary: 핵심요약 이형일 차관 주재, 관계부처 합동 홈플러스TF 회의 홈플러스 근로자·협력업체 지원방안 이행상황 점검 연합뉴스 홈플러스 회생절차 폐지 이후 발생한 임금체불 규모가 333억 원으로 확인됐다. 정부는 근로자를 위해 대지급금이 신속하게 지급될 수 있도록 지원하겠다는 방침이다.

headlines.title: 총 4회에 걸쳐 '부동산 대토론회 ' … 공급·대출·세금, 여론에 묻는다
headlines.summary: 정부, 14~16일 사흘연속 개최 23일엔 李대통령이 직접 주재 정부가 보유세 강화 등 부동산 세제 개편을 준비 중인 가운데 여론 수렴을 위해 모두 네 차례에 걸쳐 토론회를 열기로 했다. 14~16일에 국토교통부, 금융위원회, 재정경제부가 각각 공급, 금융, 세금을 주제로 공개 토론회를 개최한다.

headlines.title: 靑 " 청년대출 완화 고민 "… 보유세 는 '초고가 기준' 쟁점
headlines.summary: 李대통령, 7개 핵심 쟁점 제시 생애최초 대출 6억 한도 집값 상승 맞춰 완화 검토 초고가 기준·적정 세율 논의 비거주 1주택 증세도 도마 이재명 대통령이 이르면 이달 말 발표될 내년도 세제 개편안을 통해 다주택·초고가 주택에 대한 보유세를 강화하겠다는 방침을 시사했다.

headlines.title: 미국 상무장관 , 마이크론 행사서 " 삼전닉스 미국 생산 확대" 촉구
headlines.summary: ▲ 하워드 러트닉 미국 상무장관 하워드 러트닉 미국 상무장관이 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스에 미국 내 메모리 반도체 생산 확대를 촉구했습니다. 러트닉 장관은 9일(현지 시간) 삼성·하이닉스의 경쟁사인 마이크론이 미국 뉴욕주 클레이 타운에 건설 중인 팹(반도체 생산공장)의 콘크리트 타설 기념식 현장에서 이같이 말했다고 블룸버그 통신이 보도했습니다.

headlines.title: 월 80만원만 벌어도 … 고용보험 가입 길 열려
headlines.summary: 고용보험법 개정령안 예고 근로시간서 월보수 기준으로 합산제 신설…35만명이 혜택 정부가 고용보험 가입 기준을 근로 시간에서 소득으로 개편한다. 월 보수 80만원 이상이면 근로 시간과 관계없이 고용보험에 가입할 수 있게 된다. 고용노동부는 10일 이 같은 내용을 담은 고용보험법 및 고용산재보험료징수법 하위법령 일부 개정령안을 40일간 입법 예고한다고 밝혔다.

key_headlines.title: South Korea to Hold Series of Real Estate Grand Debates on Supply, Lending, and Taxation
key_headlines.summary: The government will conduct four real estate policy debate sessions from July 14-16, with President Lee presiding on July 23, as it prepares to strengthen property holding tax and reform real estate taxation.

key_headlines.title: Employment Insurance Eligibility Expanded to Include Workers Earning 800,000 Won Monthly
key_headlines.summary: The government is revising employment insurance criteria from working hours to income-based standards, allowing approximately 350,000 workers earning 800,000 won or more monthly to enroll regardless of hours worked.

key_headlines.title: U.S. Commerce Secretary Urges Samsung and SK Hynix to Expand Memory Chip Production in America
key_headlines.summary: U.S. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick encouraged Samsung and SK Hynix to increase domestic memory semiconductor production capacity while attending Micron's fab groundbreaking ceremony in New York.

key_headlines.title: Homeplus Wage Arrears Confirmed at 33.3 Billion Won; Government to Rapidly Distribute Lump-Sum Payments
key_headlines.summary: Following the court's decision to terminate Homeplus' corporate restructuring proceedings, the government confirmed wage arrears of 33.3 billion won in June and pledged to quickly distribute compensation to affected workers.

key_headlines.title: Bank of Korea Likely to Raise Base Rate for First Time in 3.5 Years at July 16 Monetary Policy Meeting
key_headlines.summary: The central bank raised its 2026 GDP growth forecast to 2.6% and inflation outlook to 2.7%, signaling a potential rate hike at the upcoming monetary policy committee meeting as inflation pressures persist.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's government is intensifying policy engagement on real estate reform through a series of public debates scheduled for mid-July, addressing supply, lending, and taxation issues. The government has also expanded employment insurance eligibility to low-wage workers earning 800,000 won monthly, benefiting approximately 350,000 additional workers. Meanwhile, the Homeplus insolvency situation continues to impact the government agenda, with confirmed wage arrears of 33.3 billion won requiring rapid compensation measures. International pressure is mounting on Korean semiconductor companies, as the U.S. Commerce Secretary publicly urged Samsung and SK Hynix to expand American production capacity.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The Bank of Korea is poised to raise its base rate for the first time in 3.5 years at the July 16 monetary policy committee meeting, with analysts predicting unanimous support for a rate increase. The central bank has significantly upgraded its economic outlook, raising the 2026 GDP growth forecast from 2.0% to 2.6% and inflation expectations from 2.2% to 2.7%, reflecting stronger-than-expected economic performance. The government is preparing to announce its second-half economic growth strategy and revised forecasts, with expectations that semiconductor supercycles and improved domestic demand may exceed initial projections. First-quarter real GDP growth reached 1.7%, marking the largest quarterly expansion in five years since late 2020, providing the backdrop for monetary tightening.
sections.Financial Markets: SK Hynix' successful NASDAQ listing has sparked a reverse kimchi premium phenomenon, with the company's American depositary shares trading 16% higher than domestic shares, attracting global investor interest in Korean semiconductor stocks. The Korean stock market experienced volatility this week, with both KOSPI and KOSDAQ triggering circuit breakers due to rapid gains, reflecting renewed investor enthusiasm despite geopolitical tensions. Banking stocks demonstrated resilience amid market fluctuations, driven by favorable earnings prospects and rising interest rate environments that boost net interest margins and capital market revenues. SK Hynix' $26.5 billion capital raise from its NASDAQ listing is expected to provide substantial foreign exchange inflows as the company converts dollars to won for domestic investments, potentially stabilizing the foreign exchange market.
sections.Industry & Technology: The government is advancing Samsung's Yongin semiconductor fab operation timeline by two years to 2029, recognizing the urgent need to secure production capacity amid AI-driven memory chip supply shortages. Global competition for semiconductor manufacturing supremacy is intensifying, with American firm Micron and Chinese competitors aggressively expanding capacity, forcing Korean manufacturers to accelerate investment plans. The government has designated 32 key chemical technology patents as national strategic technologies, including those for high-bandwidth memory packaging and energy storage systems used in AI data centers and semiconductor manufacturing. Battery subscription services for electric vehicles are being promoted with potential government subsidies to leasing companies, aiming to reduce consumer costs while supporting the EV transition.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul's apartment price surge has triggered a shift in demand toward alternative properties, with villas and multi-unit residences experiencing significant appreciation as buyers seek more affordable options. Multi-unit housing prices in Seoul rose 3.37% during the first five months of 2026, more than five times the previous year's growth rate, while jeonse (long-term lease) prices surged 1.94%, reaching a 13-year high monthly increase in May. Political controversy surrounds the government's real estate policies, with opposition parties criticizing the administration for rising housing prices and limited accessibility to homeownership. Premium locations with strong school districts continue to dominate market dynamics, reinforcing the principle that location remains the most critical factor in property appreciation.
sections.International Economy: The U.S. Federal Reserve is implementing structural reforms under new Chair Kevin Warsh, establishing five task forces to examine communications, balance sheet policy, data analysis, productivity and employment, and inflation frameworks, signaling a departure from conventional central banking practices. Global trade dynamics are shifting as multilateral trade agreements outside the U.S. framework proliferate, with Korea recently establishing new trade relationships with India and the UK, potentially diversifying economic dependency away from American markets. The Fed is expected to remain cautious on rate cuts despite earlier easing bias signals, with market expectations for only one rate increase through the remainder of 2026, suggesting a more measured policy approach than previously anticipated. U.S.-Iran tensions are escalating around the Hormuz Strait, creating uncertainty in global crude oil markets and potentially volatilizing currency markets as geopolitical risks resurface.
sections.AI & Economy: SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won dismissed semiconductor peak-out concerns, affirming aggressive expansion plans for memory chip production as AI infrastructure demand is expected to sustain through at least 2028. Samsung and SK Hynix are racing to expand production capacity to capitalize on the AI-driven memory chip supercycle, with both companies advancing facility investments ahead of international competitors. KB Financial Group is accelerating AI transformation across all business divisions as a core medium-term strategy, focusing on asset management redesign, corporate banking expansion, and advanced investment management capabilities. The emerging 'one-person unicorn' era is reshaping venture capital dynamics, as AI agents enable smaller teams to achieve exponential productivity and innovation without proportional headcount expansion.
sections.Others: SK Hynix' NASDAQ listing generated a $26.5 billion capital influx that is expected to be converted into won for domestic investments, effectively injecting massive dollar supplies into Korea's foreign exchange market and potentially alleviating currency volatility. The government is adjusting transit subsidy policies for elderly citizens, with plans to raise the free subway age threshold to 70 years, projected to increase annual transportation revenues by approximately 57.2 billion won while supporting monthly bus usage for low-income seniors. Alternative investment institutions are facing liquidity challenges despite the abundance of capital in the broader market, as investors increasingly favor bank deposits over private equity funds amid stock market sluggishness. Regional geopolitical tensions, particularly escalating U.S.-Iran conflicts, are creating commodity price uncertainties and raising risk premiums across global financial markets.
